question: Makaravilakku festival is celebrated at the sacred grove of Lord Ayyappa in:
solution:
The correct answer is __Kerala__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Makaravilakku is an annual festival held on Makar Sankranti in the **Kerala **state.

 Makaravilakku is an annual festival held on Makara Sankranti at the Sabarimala Ayyappa temple in Kerala.

 
 
• Makara Jyothi is a star that appears in the sky on Makara Samkramam, when the Sun moves from dhanu Rasi (Sagittarius) to Makaram Rasi (Capricorn) on the first day of the Malayalam month of Makaram, January 14 (Makara Sankranti) this year.
 
• Onam is the most important and popular festival in Kerala. Celebrated with much pomp and fervor, Onam is a harvest festival.
